## Store item checklist (if adding/updating a registry item)

- [ ] `marblo.yaml` validates against `registry/manifest.schema.json`
- [ ] `id` is unique and kebab-case
- [ ] First-party: real files included · Referenced: `source.repository` + a pinned tag/SHA (not a branch)
- [ ] `permissions`, `compatibility.harnesses`, and `license` declared
- [ ] No secrets, model weights, large datasets, or copied third-party code/docs
